title: Sendium - SMS Operations
description: Raw totals and account totals are since the selected application instance started, evaluated at the selected range end, not increments within that range. Changing the range duration with its end at now does not change totals. Rates and estimated period mixes follow the selected period. Sources, selections, provider attempts and receipt outcomes have different units. No data is not zero.

panels.title: Totals since application start - at range end, not period counts
Accepted submissions - since start
panels.description: Raw accepted ingress counter for this instance; resets on restart. Counts accepted sources/parts and repeated submissions, not unique customer SMS or billing totals.

panels.title: Provider attempts - since start
panels.description: Raw provider-part request invocations including retries. Not unique submissions. Resets on restart; evaluated at range end, not an increment over the selected period.

panels.title: Delivered outcomes - since start
panels.description: Raw committed delivered correlation-state transitions, following multipart aggregation. Not a conversion rate of accepted submissions. Resets on restart; evaluated at range end, not a selected-period count.

panels.title: Failed / expired outcomes - since start
panels.description: Raw final failed/expired receipt outcomes, not admission rejections or local retention expiry. An absent series is No data, not an invented zero. Resets on restart; evaluated at range end, not a selected-period count.

panels.title: Traffic and outcomes - time-filtered rates and estimated mixes
Admission decisions / second
panels.description: HTTP/SMPP accepted and rejected decisions. Rates follow the selected time range and rate window.

panels.title: Final receipt outcomes / second
panels.description: Committed delivered, failed and expired transitions only. Provider acceptance is not handset delivery.

panels.title: Admission mix - estimated selected period
panels.description: Estimated accepted/rejected increases over the selected period. Boundary extrapolation may change values while traffic is idle. Not the raw totals above; no activity has no meaningful ratio.

panels.title: Receipt outcome mix - estimated selected period
panels.description: Mix of final receipt events, not delivery conversion of submissions admitted in the same period. Uses extrapolated increase estimates, unlike since-start cards.

panels.title: Accepted traffic / second by account
panels.description: Aggregates credentials sharing an authenticated accountId across HTTP/SMPP. Missing configured accountId is omitted; provider/receipt attribution is not included. Account series appear after first accepted submission.

panels.title: Accepted by account - since application start
panels.description: Raw accepted counters at range end, not selected-period increments; reset on restart. Missing configured accountId and best-effort collection failures can make the account sum less than global admissions. Not billing totals.

panels.title: Backlogs - overlapping ownership, do not add these counts
Pending retained sources
panels.description: Retained sources include Selected/Routed ownership. Not an exact waiting-to-send queue. Sources and selections use different units.

panels.title: Selected work by state
panels.description: Selections and retained bookkeeping, overlapping Pending ownership. Only waiting and routing occupy unassigned Selected capacity.

panels.title: Routed work by destination and state
panels.description: Active includes preparation, dispatch and handoff. Waiting excludes preparation FIFO. Not the number of provider requests in flight.

panels.title: Receipt backlog - cached PostgreSQL snapshot
panels.description: waiting_provider: awaiting final provider receipts. pending_forward: forwarding to submitting application, including active attempts/retry waits. failed_forward: stored failed forwarding. Default refresh 60s. Unavailable is not zero. Select one collector per shared database.

panels.title: Provider requests awaiting response
panels.description: Current provider-part requests awaiting first response, not logical selections or unique customer SMS.

panels.title: Provider response results / second
panels.description: First accepted/rejected/timeout/transport/protocol results. Acceptance does not mean handset delivery.

panels.title: Receipt forwarding attempts / second
panels.description: Logical forwarding attempts to the submitting application. Retrying may forward the same receipt again.

panels.title: Receipt snapshot available - current
panels.description: 1 = complete fresh snapshot; 0 = unavailable. Not application readiness or a guarantee of message delivery.

panels.title: Receipt snapshot age - current
panels.description: Time since last complete successful snapshot. Default collection interval is 60s. No data before first successful collection.
